verses.text: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!

xrefs.text: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come! Let the one who hears say, “Come! And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.
For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.

verses.text: Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.

xrefs.text: I am the bread of life.
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
“For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug their own cisterns— broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

verses.text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.

xrefs.text: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’

verses.text: Behold, I have made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.

xrefs.text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.

verses.text: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”

xrefs.text: Then you will look and be radiant, and your heart will tremble and swell with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
“On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and they will become My people. I will dwell among you, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.

Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
Thus declares the Lord GOD, who gathers the dispersed of Israel: “I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered.”

verses.text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

xrefs.text: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

verses.text: Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.

xrefs.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
But if the wicked man turns from all the sins he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.
In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.
I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.

verses.text: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.

xrefs.text: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are My ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

verses.text: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.

xrefs.text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.text: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,

xrefs.text: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.
I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season— showers of blessing.
Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.

verses.text: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.

xrefs.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth, a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.

verses.text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

xrefs.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.

verses.text: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up; this will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”

xrefs.text: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees. I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,

So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
